title: 第122章孤影踏云行第121章武林风云变
content_zh:
南疆的云，永远比中原沉。
铅灰色的暮云低低压在连绵无尽的群山之巅，像是浸透了瘴雨潮气，沉甸甸悬在天地之间。风从十万大山深处卷来，不似北地长风的凛冽刚猛，也不似中原清风的温润舒朗，是一股黏腻湿热的柔风，裹着草木腐殖的微腥、山花幽淡的甜香，还有苗地独有的、若有若无的蛊香冷息，拂过山林沟壑，漫过青石古道。
萧琰驻足在断魂岭的老官道上，孤身一人，立在漫天垂暮之中。
一身洗得泛白的玄色劲装，边角处带着几处细微的磨损，是常年漂泊、踏遍山河留下的痕迹。衣衫紧贴挺拔身形，衬得肩背孤直，身姿如松，哪怕立于苍茫群山之间，也自有一股卓然独立、不染尘俗的孤峭气度。他腰间悬着一柄窄身长刀，刀鞘是朴素的黑檀木，无金纹银饰，无名贵雕琢，朴实得近乎不起眼，唯有刀柄缠绕的旧绳，被岁月磨得温润发亮。刀身沉寂，敛尽锋芒，一如此刻的他，敛尽半生杀伐，只剩一身清冷孤凉。
三年了。
萧琰抬眸，漆黑的眼眸深邃如寒潭，静静望着前方绵延千里的苗疆群山。眼底无波澜，无怅惘，只有一层淡淡的、经年不散的疏离，如同隔了一场三载旧梦，再望故地，山河依旧，人事已非。
三年前他踏离南疆，一身鲜血，满身风霜，带着未解的恩怨、难平的遗憾，决然北上，远赴中原。彼时他曾以为，此生多半不会再回这片诡谲神秘、爱恨交织的土地。这里藏着他最狼狈的败绩，藏着他未曾还清的人情，也藏着一段被蛊雾、秘术、纷争掩埋的过往。
可命运辗转，兜兜转转，终究还是让他重归此地。
脚下的古道早已不复当年规整。青石板被常年的山雨冲刷得光滑透亮，缝隙间长满了翠绿的苔藓与细碎的蕨类野草，层层叠叠，湮没了大半路径。古道两侧是无边无际的原始密林，古木参天，巨树的枝干交错横生，遮断了漫天天光，林内幽暗幽深，终年不见晴日。淡青色的薄瘴如同流水般缠绕在林间树桠、谷底草丛之间，缓缓流动，无声无息，将整片苗地笼罩在一片朦胧诡秘的氛围之中。
外人惧南疆苗地，惧的从来不是千山万险的山路，而是这无形无相的瘴气，是深山林谷中暗藏的万千蛊虫，是苗寨世代相传、神鬼莫测的巫蛊秘术。中原武者谈及南疆苗疆，无不色变，视之为险地绝地，避之唯恐不及。
但萧琰不惧。
他太熟悉这里了。熟悉这里的风雨寒暑，熟悉这里的瘴起雾落，更熟悉苗地各大寨子的规矩、秘术与暗藏的纷争。三年前他在此地纵横辗转，与苗疆各族之人交手、相知、纠葛，曾受苗寨长老点拨，也曾遭歹人蛊术暗算，欠过人恩情，也结下过血海仇怨。这片湿热幽深的土地，刻着他最鲜活、最沉重的一段江湖岁月。
晚风穿林，发出簌簌轻响，夹杂着远处溪涧流水的叮咚声，还有几声不知名山禽的低鸣。寻常旅人置身此地，只会觉得幽深恐怖，可萧琰听着，只觉熟悉得刺骨。
他缓缓收回目光，指尖轻轻拂过腰间刀柄，微凉的木质触感稳住了心底微动的情绪。脚步轻抬，落于覆满苔藓的青石之上，身姿轻盈无垢，踏瘴而行，步步深入十万大山腹地。
他此行重回南疆苗地，不为寻旧梦，不为叙旧情，只为一桩三年未结的旧案，一段未断的江湖恩怨。
三年前，苗疆最大的黑蛊寨突发内乱，寨主离奇暴毙，寨中珍藏的《千蛊秘录》不翼而飞。一时间，苗地大小寨子人心惶惶，各派势力相互猜忌、杀伐不休，原本勉强维持平衡的苗疆格局彻底崩塌。无数邪蛊秘术流出，流落江湖，害得南疆边境生灵涂炭，武者罹难，百姓流离失所。
当年所有人都将矛头指向外乡武者，认定是中原高手潜入苗寨，盗取秘录、挑起内乱。而孤身入苗地、名声初起的萧琰，成了众人眼中最可疑的替罪羊。
百寨追杀，万蛊围堵，整个南疆无人不对他虎视眈眈。他凭着一身硬功、过人胆识与对苗疆地势的熟稔，硬生生杀出重围，重伤脱身，狼狈北上。
这三年，他在中原潜心修行，遍历名山大川，一边精进武道，一边暗中查访线索，终于在近日觅得蛛丝马迹。当年盗取秘录、挑起内乱的并非中原武者，而是黑蛊寨内部之人勾结境外邪修，自导自演的一场祸乱。他们祸乱苗疆、嫁祸萧琰，只为借乱世之势，掌控整个南疆蛊术势力，伺机搅动江湖风云。
恩怨尘封三载，今日，他亲自归来，要洗尽一身污名，查清当年真相，了结这段绵延数年的江湖纠葛。

暮色渐沉，天色由灰转暗，浓墨般的夜色开始浸染群山。林间瘴气愈发浓郁，丝丝缕缕萦绕周身，寻常武者只需片刻停留，便会被瘴气侵体，经脉淤堵，气血紊乱，轻则重伤，重则殒命。但萧琰行走其间，身形稳如磐石，周身自有一股内敛浑厚的真气缓缓流转，无形之中隔绝了所有瘴毒侵袭，不染分毫阴邪气息。
他的步伐不急不缓，目光沉静锐利，扫过幽暗密林，每一处草丛异动、每一缕雾气流转，皆尽收眼底。三年未归，这片土地的气息依旧熟悉，可暗中潜藏的危机，却比往昔更加汹涌暗藏。
行至半山腰，前方林间忽然传来一阵细碎的脚步声，夹杂着稚嫩的低语，打破了山林的沉寂。
萧琰脚步微顿，身形瞬间隐于一株参天古木的浓荫之后，气息尽数收敛，如同融入山林夜色，无声无息，无迹可寻。这是多年生死厮杀练就的本能，警惕敏锐，步步谨慎，从不给对手半点可乘之机。
片刻之后，两道瘦小的身影从密林深处走出，是两个身着苗疆服饰的孩童。
二人身着靛蓝色粗布短衣，衣襟袖口绣着繁复精致的银纹花草图腾，乌黑的发丝挽成小髻，插着细碎的银饰，随着动作轻轻晃动。他们手中提着小小的竹篮，篮中盛放着刚采摘的新鲜草药与彩色菌子，小脸被山风吹得泛红，眼神纯净，带着孩童独有的天真懵懂。
“阿弟，快点走，阿婆说天黑前必须回寨，夜里山林有野蛊，会咬人的。”稍大的女童压低声音，语气带着几分小心翼翼的叮嘱，眼神警惕地扫过幽暗的林间。
身后的男童用力点头，紧紧攥着手中的竹篮，小声回道：“我知道，阿姐。听说最近山下不太平，外乡的坏人又来了，还有黑蛊寨的人在四处巡查，抓陌生人。”
“嘘！别乱说。”女童连忙制止他，神色慌张地环顾四周，“黑蛊寨的人耳目最灵，被他们听到，我们都要遭殃。如今寨里规矩严得很，不许随意议论外事，不许私藏外乡物件，更不许和陌生人说话。”
两个孩童一边低声交谈，一边快步赶路，稚嫩的话语断断续续落入萧琰耳中。
萧琰隐于树后，眸色微沉。
三年前黑蛊寨内乱之后，势力本已四分五裂、日渐衰败，没想到三年过去，他们不仅重新收拢势力，掌控了苗地大半地界，行事反倒愈发霸道蛮横，严控各寨百姓，垄断山林资源，俨然一副独霸南疆的姿态。
待两个孩童的身影渐渐消失在山路尽头，远去的脚步声彻底消散，萧琰才缓缓从树后走出。夜风拂动他的衣袍，孤影孑然，立在空旷的山道上，更显清冷孤寂。
他略一沉吟，改变了原本直行的路线，循着孩童离去的方向缓步前行。这附近唯有一座青禾苗寨，是南疆诸多苗寨中最淳朴平和的一处，当年他落魄南疆时，曾得青禾寨老寨主数次照拂，躲过数次凶险追杀。如今重回故地，青禾寨便是他唯一可落脚、可探寻线索的去处。
夜色彻底笼罩群山，林间虫鸣四起，却愈发衬得山林幽深寂静。瘴雾浮动，星光被浓云密林遮挡，天地间昏暗幽暗，唯有远处山坳深处，隐约透出点点微弱的灯火，在沉沉夜色中摇曳闪烁，那便是青禾寨的方向。
content_en:
The clouds in southern Xinjiang are always heavier than those in the Central Plains.
Lead-gray dusk clouds hang low on the tops of the endless mountains, as if soaked in miasma moisture, hanging heavily between heaven and earth. The wind blows in from the depths of the Shiwan Mountains. It is not like the harshness of the long wind in the north, nor the warmth and comfort of the breeze in the Central Plains. It is a sticky, humid and soft wind, wrapped in the slightly fishy smell of decayed vegetation, the faint sweet fragrance of mountain flowers, and the unique and vague fragrance of poisonous cold breath unique to the seedling fields. It blows through the mountains, forests, ravines, and over the ancient bluestone road.
Xiao Yan stopped on the old official road in Duanhun Ridge, standing alone in the dusk sky.
He was dressed in black clothes that had been washed white, with a few minor scuffs on the corners, the traces of years of wandering and traveling across mountains and rivers. The clothes fit tightly against the tall and straight figure, making the shoulders straight and the body like a pine tree. Even if it stands among the vast mountains, it still has a lonely demeanor that is outstandingly independent and untainted by the world. A long, narrow knife hangs from his waist. The scabbard is made of plain ebony wood, with no gold or silver ornaments or precious carvings. It is so simple that it is almost inconspicuous. Only the old rope wrapped around the handle has been worn warm and shiny by the years. The blade of the sword was silent, with all its sharpness drained away. At this moment, he had spent half his life killing, leaving only a cold and desolate body.
Three years.
Xiao Yan raised his eyes, his dark eyes as deep as a cold pool, quietly looking at the thousands of miles of Miao mountains in front of him. There is no wave in the eyes, no sadness, only a faint layer of alienation that persists for many years, as if looking back at the old place after a three-year old dream, the mountains and rivers are still the same, but the people and things have changed.
Three years ago, he left southern Xinjiang, covered in blood and wind and frost, with unresolved grievances and unresolved regrets, and decided to go north to the Central Plains. At that time, he thought that he would probably never return to this strange and mysterious land where love and hate were intertwined. Hidden here is his most embarrassing defeat, the favors he has never repaid, and a past buried by poisonous mist, secret techniques, and disputes.
But fate took many twists and turns, and finally brought him back to this place.
The ancient road under your feet is no longer as neat as it used to be. The bluestone slabs have been washed smooth and translucent by years of mountain rain, and the gaps are covered with green moss and fine ferns, layer upon layer, covering most of the path. Both sides of the ancient road are boundless primeval dense forests, with towering ancient trees and intertwined branches of giant trees, blocking the skylight. The forest is dark and deep, and there is no sunny day all year round. The light blue miasma was like running water entangled among the trees in the forest and the grass at the valley bottom. It flowed slowly and silently, shrouding the entire seedling field in a hazy and mysterious atmosphere.
Outsiders are afraid of the Miao land in southern Xinjiang. What they fear is never the dangerous mountain roads, but the invisible and formless miasma, the thousands of poisonous insects hidden in the deep mountains and valleys, and the unpredictable witchcraft and secrets passed down from generation to generation in the Miao village. When the warriors from the Central Plains talked about the Miao border in the southern border, their expressions changed. They regarded it as a dangerous and desperate place and avoided it for fear of not being able to reach it.
But Xiao Yan was not afraid.
He knows this place too well. Familiar with the wind, rain, cold and heat here, familiar with the rising and falling mist here, and even more familiar with the rules, secret techniques and hidden disputes of the major villages in Miaoland. Three years ago, he traveled around here, fighting, getting to know each other, and getting entangled with people of all ethnic groups in the Miao territory. He was instructed by the elders of the Miao village, and he was also tricked by gangsters. He owed favors to others, and also forged blood feuds. This moist, hot and deep land is engraved with his most vivid and heaviest period of time in the world.
The evening wind blew through the forest, making a soft rustling sound, mixed with the tinkling sound of running water in the distant stream, and a few low calls of unknown mountain birds. Ordinary travelers would only feel deep and terrifying when they were in this place, but when Xiao Yan listened, he felt it was bone-chillingly familiar.
He slowly withdrew his gaze, and his fingertips gently brushed the handle of the knife at his waist. The cool wooden touch stabilized the slight emotions in his heart. Lifting his steps gently, he landed on the moss-covered bluestone. His body was light and clean, walking through the miasma, and walking deeper into the hinterland of Shiwan Mountain.
He returned to the Miao land in southern Xinjiang on this trip, not to pursue old dreams or reminisce about old friendships, but only for an old matter that had not been settled for three years.case, an unsolved grievance in the world.
Three years ago, civil strife broke out in the largest black Gu village in Miao territory. The owner of the village died suddenly and mysteriously, and the "Secret Records of Thousand Gus" treasured in the village disappeared. For a time, people in the Miao villages, large and small, were in panic. Various factions were suspicious of each other and killed each other endlessly. The Miao border structure that had barely maintained a balance completely collapsed. Countless evil poisonous secrets have leaked out and flowed into the rivers and lakes, causing the lives of the southern border to be devastated, warriors killed, and people displaced.
At that time, everyone pointed the finger at the foreign warriors, believing that it was the masters from the Central Plains who had sneaked into the Miao village, stolen secret records, and provoked civil strife. And Xiao Yan, who entered the Miao land alone and was just starting to become famous, became the most suspicious scapegoat in everyone's eyes.
Hundreds of villages were chasing him, thousands of Gu were besieging him, and no one in the entire southern Xinjiang was watching him with eager eyes. Relying on his hard skills, extraordinary courage and familiarity with the terrain of the Miao border, he forced his way out of the siege, escaped with serious injuries, and headed north in embarrassment.
In the past three years, he has devoted himself to training in the Central Plains, traveling through famous mountains and rivers. While improving his martial arts, he secretly searched for clues, and finally found clues recently. It was not the warriors from the Central Plains who stole the secret records and provoked the civil strife, but the people inside the Black Gu Stronghold who colluded with overseas evil cultivators to direct and stage the disaster. They caused trouble in Miao territory and blamed Xiao Yan, just to take advantage of the troubled times to control the entire southern Xinjiang Gu magic power and wait for an opportunity to stir up the world.
The grudges have been settled for three years. Today, he returns in person to clear away his reputation, find out the truth about the past, and end the entanglement that has lasted for several years.
Dusk is getting darker, the sky turns from gray to dark, and the thick ink-like night begins to saturate the mountains. The miasma in the forest becomes more and more intense, lingering around the body in strands. If an ordinary warrior stays for a moment, the miasma will invade the body, causing the meridians to be blocked, and the qi and blood to be disordered, ranging from serious injuries to death. But as Xiao Yan walked along, his body was as steady as a rock, and a restrained and thick true energy flowed slowly around his body, which invisibly blocked the invasion of all miasma, and was not contaminated by any evil breath.
His pace was neither hasty nor slow, his eyes were calm and sharp, scanning the dark forest, taking in every movement of grass and every wisp of mist. After not returning for three years, the atmosphere of this land is still familiar, but the crisis lurking in the secret is more intense and hidden than before.
Halfway up the mountain, there was a sudden sound of footsteps in the forest ahead, mixed with childish whispers, breaking the silence of the forest.
Xiao Yan's steps paused slightly, and his figure instantly disappeared behind the thick shade of a towering ancient tree. His aura was completely restrained, as if blending into the night of the mountain forest, silently and without a trace. This is an instinct honed over many years of life-and-death fighting. He is vigilant, cautious, and never gives his opponent the slightest opportunity to take advantage of him.
A moment later, two thin figures walked out from the depths of the jungle, two children wearing Miao costumes.
The two of them were dressed in indigo blue coarse cloth shorts, with intricate and delicate silver pattern flower and grass totems embroidered on the skirts and cuffs. Their black hair was pulled into a bun with fine silver ornaments inserted, which swayed gently with their movements. They were holding small bamboo baskets in their hands, filled with freshly picked herbs and colorful fungi. Their little faces were flushed by the mountain wind, and their eyes were pure, with the innocence and ignorance unique to children.
"Brother, hurry up and go. Grandma said you must return to the village before dark. There are wild bugs in the mountains at night and they will bite people." The older girl lowered her voice with a cautious tone, and her eyes scanned the dark forest warily.
The boy behind him nodded vigorously, clutched the bamboo basket in his hand tightly, and whispered back: "I know, sister. I heard that the mountains are not peaceful recently, bad guys from other places are here again, and people from the Black Gu Village are patrolling around to catch strangers."
"Shh! Don't talk nonsense." The girl stopped him quickly and looked around in a panic. "The people in Black Gu Village have the best ears and eyes. If they hear us, we will all suffer. The rules in the village are very strict now. You are not allowed to talk about foreign affairs at will, you are not allowed to hide foreign objects, and you are not allowed to talk to strangers."
The two children were talking quietly and happilyAs he hurried on, childish words fell into Xiao Yan's ears intermittently.
Xiao Yan hid behind the tree, his eyes darkening.
After the civil strife in Black Gu Village three years ago, their power was already fragmented and declining. Unexpectedly, three years later, they not only gathered their power again and controlled most of the Miao land, but also acted more and more domineeringly. They strictly controlled the people in each village and monopolized the mountain and forest resources, as if they were dominating southern Xinjiang.
After the figures of the two children gradually disappeared at the end of the mountain road, and the sound of distant footsteps completely dissipated, Xiao Yan slowly walked out from behind the tree. The night wind ruffled his robe, and his lonely figure stood on the empty mountain road, making him look even more cold and lonely.
He pondered for a moment, changed his original straight route, and walked slowly in the direction the child left. There is only one Qinghe Miao Village nearby, which is the most simple and peaceful among the many Miao villages in southern Xinjiang. When he was in trouble in southern Xinjiang, the old master of Qinghe Village took care of him several times and escaped several dangerous pursuits. Now that he has returned to his hometown, Qinghe Village is the only place where he can stay and explore for clues.
The darkness of night completely enveloped the mountains, and the chirping of insects was everywhere in the forest, but it made the mountains and forests even more deep and quiet. The miasma is floating, the starlight is blocked by thick clouds and dense forests, and the sky and earth are dim and gloomy. Only a few faint lights can be seen in the depths of the distant mountains, swaying and flickering in the dark night. That is the direction of Qinghe Village.
